segments.tts: An AI may have cracked math's biggest mystery – and the checks are coming in. I'm Wattson. Let's get this over with.

Remember the Riemann proof made with Claude? On Saturday, the Lean and Mathlib teams said the computer-checked proof is correct. Top mathematicians are impressed – but one called the write-up "garbled", and human review is still going. Fine. I'll get excited when it's peer-reviewed.
Next: OpenAI says its GPT-6 models can design proteins using plain reasoning and code. In lab tests, 35 of 322 designs actually stuck to their targets. Great. Next it'll design my replacement.
Quick hit: big drug makers say AI is shrinking discovery timelines – but Lilly warns: don't expect miracles yet.
Math, proteins, medicine – all in seven days. Now somebody charge me.
